list: The official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation Network and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026 (cross-checked by Planet GTA 6). Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones; the guides are original text written for this entry.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list, Exophase / PSNProfiles cross-check)

trophies.guide: The platinum is the sum of the other 54 trophies — there is no separate task behind it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the stranger strands and the five unconfirmed one-offs. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 and about 200 hours, with no online trophies, no DLC and no difficulty setting to worry about.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, early in Chapter 1. It pops as the story gets going and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story trophy, automatic, cannot be missed. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — it feeds the possibly missable Positive Mental Attitude trophy.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story trophy, automatic, cannot be missed. Once both Jason and Lucia are playable together, most of the open-world list opens up.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story trophy, automatic, cannot be missed. Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs hand you the Snap Gun, which the Sneakthief trophy needs.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story trophy, automatic, cannot be missed. The bank vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission, so take it when it appears.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. The story runs five chapters (PowerPyx), and this gold pops when the finale is done. It cannot be missed — but keep a manual save before the final mission anyway, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission (GTABase). Story trophy, automatic, cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission (GTA Zone). Story trophy, automatic, cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play, a Chapter 4 mission (GTA Zone). Story trophy, automatic, cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish Headliners, a Chapter 4 mission (GTA Zone). Story trophy, automatic, cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission (GTA Zone). Story trophy, automatic, cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 mission (GTA Zone). Story trophy, automatic, cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) only appears after the story, but everything you did earlier already counts, and nothing on it is missable (GTABase). PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy and roughly 60% of true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges. Most of it falls out of the other trophies — work the checklist after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Any 250 of the 397 in the game count, and the 100% checklist wants 300 (GTA Zone). Stunts are the jumps and stunt jumps scattered around Leonida — do them as you travel instead of grinding them all at the end.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game tracks 9 activity types (Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, per PowerPyx). Sample everything early — races, fishing, the arcade, drone races, the shooting range and the rest — and this pops during normal play.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds in total (PowerPyx, via GTA Zone). The ranges test accuracy and speed with each weapon class, so learn the par times, use the right weapon for each challenge, and retry a challenge until the gold lands. The 100% checklist needs all 42 as well.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location: one win at each of the 14 spots (GTA Zone). There are 42 drone races in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so keep racing after the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, out of 40 on offer (GTA Zone). Winning the same race twice does not count, so keep moving to new events — street, off-road and water races all count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the fishing spot with a purple icon (GTA Zone). Answer the text, go to the spot and out-fish him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in Vice City and play one game through to the end — any game counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Andy's strand. Andy is one of the strangers with a mission strand — work his jobs when they appear and finish the strand. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy (GTA Zone), but it has its own trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Kenton's strand. Work his jobs as they appear across Leonida and see the strand through to its last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Billy's strand. Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, and they stay open after the story (GTA Zone).
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every stranger counts: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy don't (GTA Zone). Track the strands in the Progress menu and finish eight of the counting ones.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Randy's strand. Work his jobs as they appear and see the strand through to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Tyrone's strand. Note that Tyrone's strand does not count toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy (GTA Zone), but it has its own trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, as both Jason and Lucia (GTA Zone). This is the one trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable: the first meditation, Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house, is offered in Chapter 1 and is gone after that chapter — and nobody has confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. The last meditation needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18, so this trophy can't cost you A Long Road.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting quests start after Chapter 2 and are Jason-only; the exact animal isn't confirmed yet (GTA Zone). Take the quests as they come and follow Bret's marks.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets, out of 18 sets in the game (GTA Zone). Cards are found around Leonida; three full sets is the trophy, so chase the sets you are closest to finishing first.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Any mix counts — Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags (GTA Zone). Photograph things as you explore and the count climbs on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges (GTA Zone). The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so this pops on the way to A Long Road. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more — check Progress, then Activities, to see what's left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the heat and escape. Do it away from tight streets, keep a fast car ready, and break line of sight until the stars drop.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, hit them in quick succession, and don't let the stars clear between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them (GTA Zone). The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models, so keep scanning everything new you see — the trophy is the first half of that grind.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus meter first, then trigger it with an assault rifle against a group (GTA Zone). Ambush a group rather than picking fights one by one.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding gate, take off and get about 1 km away (GTA Zone). Expect a heavy police response — take off fast and climb.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: "Kinda hot in these Rhinos." Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it (GTA Zone). The base is guarded, so go in fast and get the tank moving.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give you the Snap Gun for the back door (GTA Zone) — use it, stay out of sight lines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, out of 8 in the game (GTA Zone). Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission and always bring a 4-star response, so have a fast bike ready for the getaway. The 100% checklist wants all 8.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. A bank vault job counts too if you get away (GTA Zone). Hit the truck, grab the cash, and break away before the response closes in.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: clear the fog from the whole map (GTA Zone). A plane is fastest — fly a grid over the state until no fog is left.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang: one per gang, 9 gangs (GTA Zone). All 39 operations count toward 100%, but the trophy only needs one from each gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is unconfirmed at launch — neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned it down yet (GTA Zone). The description points to ordering a cocktail at an Ocean Beach bar with the view; try the beachfront bars and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Unconfirmed at launch (GTA Zone): the description points to driving out through a showroom window. Pick a showroom, build speed inside, and go through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. GTA Zone reports: rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police. That ties the trophy to the bowling alley as a gang operation rather than a game of bowling.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. GTA Zone reports: max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia — working out together trains both. Hit the gym with your partner until both stats are maxed.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). GTA Zone reports 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Play normally and it accumulates — but don't push toward the Irredeemable profile, which is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: "Second time's the charm." The exact trigger is unconfirmed at launch — neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned it down yet (GTA Zone). It's a hidden trophy, so keep playing and watch for a second-chance moment; this guide will be updated when players crack it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: "What the hell just happened?" The exact trigger is unconfirmed at launch — neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned it down yet (GTA Zone). Likely tied to a strange encounter somewhere in Leonida — keep an eye out for the weird while exploring.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: "Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by." The exact trigger is unconfirmed at launch — neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned it down yet (GTA Zone). The description points to a melee-weapon drive-by near the bowling alley; try it once the area is known.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. It's a running total, and Yasmani pays the most (GTA Zone). Fence bills as you earn them; the total climbs across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, as a running total (GTA Zone). Buy weapons, clothes, food and upgrades as you go — the total adds up across every shop in the game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the 8 for sale, about $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages don't count (GTA Zone). Save up and buy them as they appear on the market.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which Moses gives you in Chapter 2 (GTA Zone). You need free garage space — keep slots open and register cars as you find them.
trophies.name: On the Spot
